name: iLEAPP
description: iOS Logs, Events, And Plists Parser
report_description: iLEAPP is an open source project that aims to parse every known iOS artifact for the purpose of forensic analysis.
objective: Triage iOS Full File System and iTunes Backup Extractions.
source_hint: A tar, zip or gz archive, a disk image (raw image, E01, AFF, DMG or virtual disk, L01 or AD1), or a folder holding an iOS full file system extraction or a backup. Several disk images of a RAID set can be picked together.

fields.name: keychain
fields.label: Optional. Captured from the device apart from the extraction.
